title: DreamDEX historical SDK and indexer contract verification
redaction: public SDK/indexer method, field, and bounded sample metadata only

network.writePolicy: read-only historical research; no EdgeLab mainnet transaction path

boundedMainnetProbe.countRelation: exact under current public SDK cap

markets.notes: SDK listPastBinaryMarkets returns finalized/resolved market rows and stable market IDs.

resolutions.notes: SDK getMarketResolution returned opening and closing oracle answer references for a traded finalized market.

lifecycle.notes: SDK getMarketStatusHistory returned lifecycle history rows for the sample market.

candles.notes: SDK getCandles returned bounded rows with OHLC, volume, trade count, market, pool, and interval fields.

fills.notes: SDK getFills returned pool-scoped rows; raw indexer supports market_id bounded queries.

orders.notes: SDK getOrders is owner-scoped; raw indexer supports bounded market_id order queries with lifecycle and quantity fields.

bookReconstruction.notes: No native stored historical book snapshot surface was observed. Reconstruction remains disabled until order/fill lifecycle semantics are separately verified.

implementationImplications: Use Somnia mainnet chain 5031 only for read-only historical research.
Use server-side pagination and bounded limits for orders, fills, and candles.
Do not expose raw account owner fields in judge-facing historical evidence unless a future requirement explicitly justifies it.
Treat raw Market.clobStatus/finalized as the raw status source; do not depend on a non-existent raw Market.status field.
Keep reconstructed historical resting-book functionality unavailable until BOOK-001 passes.
